hypothesis: In a re-implementation of the Shreesha & Levin (2023) evolvable-competency experiment (competency gene in [1, 500] initialised in [1, 15], 1000 generations), the best individual's competency gene rises rapidly and plateaus around 470, above the competency needed to sort its genome.
pass_criterion: Pre-registered design: 30 repeats x 1000 generations, 100 embryos. 'Best individual' (primary) = the individual with the highest genotypic fitness, first in population order on ties, as in the authors' Exp3 code; secondary = the individual ranked first on phenotypic fitness. 'Needed competency' = number of inversions of the best individual's structural genome (the swaps restricted bubble sort needs to reach fitness 1.0). Using the mean over repeats per generation: pass if all of (R) the mean best-individual competency first reaches 300 by generation 50; (L) its mean over generations 801-1000 is in [440, 500]; (N) that plateau mean exceeds the mean needed competency over generations 801-1000; (S) |mean over 901-1000 minus mean over 801-900| <= 20.
fail_criterion: Pre-registered: refutes if the plateau mean (generations 801-1000) is < 400, or is not above the mean needed competency, or the mean best-individual competency never reaches 300. Any other failure of R/L/N/S -> mixed. Reported but not entering the verdict: the population maximum competency, the secondary best-individual definition, and the fraction of plateau generations in which >= 10% of the population has phenotypic fitness 1.0 (the tie condition the authors invoke for drift).
planned_datasets: competency-ga-evolvable-competency-runs (generated by analysis.py, reusing develop() and fitness() from claim-tests/levin-papers/levin-2023-competency-04/analysis.py)
https://github.com/Niwhskal/CellularCompetency (commit 2be29f96628c83613074e1d2b874e66cff9279cc; all_tests/Exp3-EvolvableCompetency.py and core_functions.py for unspecified details, not imported)

test_contract.expected_observation: Best-individual competency climbing from <= 15 to a stable plateau near 470 within the first tens of generations, above the inversion count of its genome.
test_contract.disconfirming_observation: A plateau well below 470 (< 400), at or below the needed competency, or no rise.
test_contract.admissible_datasets: Runs of the evolvable-competency model as described in the paper (competency gene range [1, 500], initial [1, 15], 1000 generations, top-10% phenotypic selection, crossover, mutation probability 0.6), with unspecified details from the authors' public code.
test_contract.inference_method: Mean over 30 repeats of the per-generation best-individual competency; plateau as the generation 801-1000 mean compared with the [440, 500] band and with the mean inversion count; rise time as first generation >= 300.
